sea_bass.description: Premium European sea bass, perfect for grilling, frying, and fine dining. Restaurant favorite across Gulf region.

mullet.name: Grey Mullet
mullet.description: Fresh Egyptian grey mullet (bouri), raised in brackish water. Excellent for grilling and smoking. Traditional favorite in Gulf cuisine.

catfish.name: Catfish
